text.tspan: Where a container's DNS query goes
Docker embedded DNS answers container names,
Default bridge: copy of the HOST resolv.conf, no name DNS
host has only 127.0.0.53? → Docker falls back to
Upstream: VPC resolver (CIDR base +2) / corporate DNS
check CoreDNS pods/logs, NetworkPolicy egress UDP/TCP 53,
Steps: cat /etc/resolv.conf → nslookup name vs ping IP → docker run --network container:<c> nicolaka/netshoot dig …
→ compare with host (dig, resolvectl) → firewall/iptables, MTU, ip_forward → fix with --dns / daemon.json "dns" / user-defined network
Containers copy resolv.conf at start: restart them after host DNS changes. MTU mismatch (VPN, overlay) breaks large UDP answers.
